gloss: to retreat; to withdraw; to retire

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {退|しりぞ}いていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to retreat; to withdraw; to step back
definitions.explanation: To move back or withdraw from a position, especially in a military or physical sense.

definitions.gloss: to retire; to step down; to resign
definitions.explanation: To withdraw from a position, office, or role. To leave the front stage of activity.

examples.japanese: {危険|きけん}を{感|かん}じて{一歩|いっぽ}{退|しりぞ}いた。
examples.english: Sensing danger, I stepped back one step.

examples.japanese: {大軍|たいぐん}を{前|まえ}にして{退|しりぞ}くしかなかった。
examples.english: Faced with a large army, there was no choice but to retreat.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}の{座|ざ}を{退|しりぞ}いた。
examples.english: He stepped down from the position of company president.

examples.japanese: {政界|せいかい}から{退|しりぞ}く{決意|けつい}をした。
examples.english: He decided to retire from politics.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}{務|つと}めた{役職|やくしょく}を{退|しりぞ}き、{後進|こうしん}に{道|みち}を{譲|ゆず}った。
examples.english: He retired from the position he had held for many years and gave way to the next generation.

notes:
A formal verb for withdrawing, retreating, or stepping down. The retreat sense is common in historical and military contexts, while the retirement sense is used in business and politics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一線|いっせん}を{退|しりぞ}く: to retire from the front line
- {政界|せいかい}から{退|しりぞ}く: to retire from politics
- {社長|しゃちょう}の{座|ざ}を{退|しりぞ}く: to step down as president
- {敵|てき}が{退|しりぞ}く: the enemy retreats

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive. The transitive counterpart is {退|しりぞ}ける (to repel, to drive back, to reject).

WRITING:
The same kanji {退|しりぞ}く is also read as ひく (to retreat, to recede) and どく (to get out of the way), but these are treated as separate words with different nuances.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {引|ひ}き{退|さ}がる: to withdraw, to back off (less formal)
- {辞任|じにん}する: to resign (from a specific position)
- {引退|いんたい}する: to retire (especially from sports or entertainment)
- {撤退|てったい}する: to withdraw, to pull out (military/business)
